newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR PORTUGAL V GERMANY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR PORTUGAL V GERMANY WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup European group nine qualifier between Portugal and Germany on Saturday:
Portugal - 1-Vitor Baia, 2-Carlos Secretario, 5-Fernando Couto, 6-Helder Cristovao, 3-Dimas Teixeira, 11-Paulinho Santos, 4-Oceano Cruz, 7-Luis Figo, 10-Rui Costa, 9-Rui Barros, 8-Joao Vieira Pinto.

Germany - 1-Andreas Koepke, 6-Matthias Sammer, 4-Juergen Kohler, 2-Stefan Reuter, 8-Markus Babbel, 5-Dieter Eilts, 3-Christian Ziege, 10-Mario Basler, 7-Andreas Moeller, 11-Fredi Bobic, 9-Juergen Klinsmann.
